title: Battery Icon
drDigitalIntro:
The battery icon shows how much power is left in your laptop.
• A full icon means plenty of charge. A nearly empty icon means plug in soon.
• Click the battery icon to see the exact percentage.
• When your laptop is plugged in, you may see a lightning bolt on the icon, meaning it is charging.
• Most laptops warn you when the battery gets below 20%, so you have time to find a charger.

playgroundTask.goal: Open the battery panel and read the percentage

steps.say: Click the battery icon in the menu bar.
Read the battery percentage, then close the panel.

drDigitalSuccess: You checked the battery — that's how you know when to plug in!
drDigitalHint: Look for the battery icon (a small rectangle) in the top-right menu bar area. Click it.
